snippet.title: GeniGods: Nezha - Official Gameplay Trailer | gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Watch the Gameplay Trailer for GeniGods: Nezha, an upcoming third-person action-adventure RPG developed by Genigods Lab. Players will embark on a grand adventure filled with ancient Chinese inspirations as Spirit Pearl. Explore vibrant locations, take on the Gods, and make sense of your mystical origins. GeniGods: Nezha is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#IGN #gamescom2026
